answer: Each submission hangs on the yarrow of a task receipt, and the hollow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The nadir of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
